Estimate from commit trailers (unsigned)

Counts cover non-merge commits reachable from HEAD.

| | All commits | With a Claude or LLM trailer |
|---|---|---|
| Commits | 10 | 8 |

| Author | Commits | With a Claude or LLM trailer |
|---|---|---|
| Jo Park | 5 | 5 |
| Riley Chen | 5 | 3 |

By month (commit date): up to the 12 most recent months with commits

| Month | Commits | With a Claude or LLM trailer |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-07 | 10 | 8 |

What this does not show
- Which lines Claude typed: this counts whole commits that carry a Claude or LLM trailer, and the lines added in those commits.
- Commits where trailers were turned off or removed: these count as having no Claude or LLM trailer.
- Squash merges: if the squashed commit message dropped the trailers, that work counts as having no Claude or LLM trailer.

Git did the counting; every number above is copied from its output.
